name: auth-failure
description: The application identity code has been revoked, so the authorizedSites query answers 401. A permanently refused credential, as opposed to the one-off 401 that auth-refresh covers. The run must END THE TASK IN ERROR: reporting zero assets and exiting 0 is what an empty tenant does, so without the error an operator sees a green task and an estate that appears to have emptied itself. The refusal is not retried either -- 401 is outside the transient retry set -- which is what the pinned request count carries. No asset page may be requested without a site.

error_contains: lansweeper: could not read the authorized sites
